digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate model escalation and sizing
propositions: models_at_or_above() with a non-Anthropic primary falls through and returns the entire ladder instead of just the primary, causing incorrect escalation to smaller-window Anthropic models
largest_window_tokens() with a non-Anthropic primary returns the ladder maximum (1000000) instead of the ladder minimum, over-stating context capacity and causing under-blocking
Pass-1 escalation downgrades from nova to claude-haiku-4-5 (smaller window, different provider) on first escalation attempt instead of retrying the operator's own model
Prerequisite-coverage escalation at prerequisites.py:260-261 jumps to claude-haiku-4-5 instead of staying on the operator's model when the primary is not in the ladder
Non-Anthropic primary models configured via REBAR_LLM_MODEL experience silent mis-location and cross-family downgrade, while default Anthropic primaries work correctly
